head_commit.message:
v0.19.0: styled voice-message player, clean fullscreen video, burst portal, banner ratio

- Audio attachments render through a custom AudioPlayer bubble (round accent play/pause, 30-bar deterministic waveform seeded by filename that doubles as a click-to-seek bar, m:ss readout) instead of the native <audio> chrome; includes the MediaRecorder-webm Infinity-duration workaround (seek far, read duration, seek back).
- Fullscreen screen-share/camera: both expanded views now fullscreen the wrapper div — Chromium overlays its own start/stop player controls when the <video> element itself is fullscreened, which read as a broken video player. VoiceStage's expanded view also gains the missing fullscreen button.
- Reaction bursts/confetti render via createPortal into <body>: as fixed-position children of the message row they could be displaced or hidden by ancestor transforms/animations (swipe rows, cc-msg-in/cc-chat-in), which killed the effect entirely for some users.
- Profile banners use aspect-[8/3] (matching the crop frame) with max-h-44 instead of a fixed h-24, so the same crop shows on phone and desktop.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
fix: serve the web app at / and /invite (explicit routes outranked the static wildcard)

The old landing routes for / and /invite/:code beat @fastify/static's /* in
fastify's router, so the freshly-built web client never showed. Both routes
now serve index.html when client/dist exists and fall back to the old pages
on API-only installs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
v0.18.0: "Playing …" game activity on desktop, web version at the server URL

- Game activity: the Electron main process polls `tasklist` (win32, no native deps, every 45s) against a ~50-title exe map and pushes changes over a new game:activity IPC; the renderer mirrors it into customStatus ("🎮 Играет в …"), which already syncs everywhere via user:update. A hand-typed status is never overridden — only statuses with our prefix are managed. Toggle in Settings → App (desktop only), on by default.
- Web version: deploy now builds client/dist on the VPS (electron binary download skipped; vite build directly — CI already typechecks) and Fastify serves it at / with an SPA fallback for non-API GETs, so https://138-16-224-172.sslip.io works in any browser. /invite/CODE deep links load the app and auto-join (AppLayout parses the path and cleans the URL). Build failure downgrades to a warning so the API deploy never breaks on the web build.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
